summary: Defines two formats and media types for representing sets of links as standalone documents: one based on JSON and one aligned with the HTTP Link header field format. It also introduces a link relation type for discovering such link sets. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: A web page can carry many connections to other things. Instead of squeezing them all into small labels, this lets them be written in one separate list, which others can find and read.
